caption: The drawing features two renderings of a dress, both seen from the front. The primary, larger dress is depicted in color and fine detail, showing a garment with short, slightly puffed sleeves, a fitted bodice, and a long skirt. The dress is patterned with vertical olive-green and off-white stripes that contain small brown motifs, and it is decorated with solid green trim along the neckline, down the center front, at the waist, and around the skirt hem, as well as on the sleeve edges. The neckline of the dress is further highlighted by a pale pink inner collar with delicate vertical stripes and a small black bow at the center front. The green trim includes buttons down the bodice and two bows, one at the waist and one near the scalloped hemline, which features an additional ruffled detail on the left side. To the right of the main dress is a smaller, lightly sketched dress in thin black lines with less detail, showing the same general shape and features seen from the front, including the short sleeves and the cinched waist. The background is a plain, unadorned beige.
title: Dress
